content.title: Prince William to Visit India: Earthshot Prize and Gully Cricket
content.caption: Prince William is set to visit India this week, where he will attend the Earthshot Prize ceremony and participate in gully cricket events.

slides.heading: Prince William to Visit India: Earthshot Prize and Gully Cricket
slides.text: Prince William is set to visit India this week, where he will attend the Earthshot Prize ceremony and participate in gully cricket events.

slides.heading: Earthshot Prize Ceremony
slides.text: The Earthshot Prize ceremony will take place on Tuesday evening in New Delhi, focused on solutions to pressing environmental problems.

slides.heading: Gully Cricket Events
slides.text: Prince William will attend gully cricket events, including a round with cricketers Sourav Ganguly, Brian Lara, and England captain Joe Root.
